name: 485-version-probe-trailing-quote-command-not-run
note: #485: the composed plugin-version command ends with --cmd-b64 <token> in the consumer capture; the probe agent typed the same text plus a final single quote, the shell answered unmatched quote (exit 1), probe-run.cjs never ran and no record exists (empty line, verify says no-record). The run ends as the documented provision-failed with probeReason command-not-run; The composed command now ends with --model haiku, so the closing quote no longer lands on the long token. The engine retries a read probe once with a fresh agent (#486): the second answer repeats the recorded failure (no raw capture of a retry exists; the next canary run replaces it).

args.brief: a stray closing quote after the composed probe command must end as command-not-run, with the command ending in a short flag
